resources.string: Doppler plan for the RT-950 Pro

Full backup, APRS configuration, APRS messages through the radio\'s KISS TNC and a Doppler channel plan. This radio has no live CAT: every memory change is a clone session that mutes RX and writes to flash.
Bluetooth permission is needed to find the radio
The radio advertises as \"walkie-talkie\" and must not be connected to another app.
Reads channels, VFO, functions, DTMF, modulation, names and APRS and saves them as a .bin with a JSON manifest and SHA-256. The areas 0x7C00-0x7FFF and 0xE000 upwards are never read or written.
Writes stay disabled until a full backup has been read in this session.
After a clone session the KISS stream may stay silent until the radio is power cycled (off and on).
The whole APRS block is written from a fresh read and verified by reading it back. If the link drops after writing, reconnect and read again to check: it is never reported as success.
The radio\'s flash will be modified:\n%1$s

Enable both menu options \"KISS TNC over BLE (RX)\" and \"(TX)\" on the radio. Reception is verified; that the radio transmits what is sent with the TX option is an unverified INFERENCE. Transmitting requires an amateur radio licence and a valid callsign.
Automatically acknowledge (ack) messages addressed to me
Doppler plan for the RT-950 Pro

This radio has no live CAT, so Doppler cannot be tracked live. Instead 5 channels (AOS, mid-rise, TCA, mid-set and LOS) are written with Doppler-corrected receive and transmit frequencies. Writing them mutes the radio for a few seconds.
Open this screen from a pass detail in Satellites to choose a transmitter and a pass.

Writes the zones of a regional template to the radio (RX only, TX locked). Requires the full backup of this session. Every written block is read back and compared.
Radio variant (you choose it; it is never auto-detected)
Choose CH990 only if you are sure your radio has 990 channels. With \"Unknown\" or \"CH960\", channels 961-990 (zone 10, slots 70-99) are never written.
First zone (1-10; empty = first empty zone in the backup)
The first zone must be between 1 and %1$d
With first zone %1$d, a plan zone would land on zone %2$d, but the last available zone is %3$d (or it collides with the PMR/CB zone). Nothing was written.
Write the template to the radio?

Zone %1$d: read-back differs from what was written (%2$s)
Some zones failed or differ: tap \"Restore backup\" to return them to the backup state.
Restore the backup to the radio?
Only the channel blocks that differ will be rewritten from this session\'s verified backup (%1$s), within the range allowed for the chosen variant. They are then read back and checked.

Nothing to restore: the radio\'s channels already match the backup
